question: Which deities must be worshipped on the tridents in this rite?
premises: The ritual specifies tridents as locations.
The worshipper is instructed to perform worship.
Eight Bhairavīs are named as recipients.
inference: The rite requires worship of eight Bhairavīs on the tridents.
plain_english: O great goddess, one should worship the eight Bhairavīs on the tridents.
